title: The Housemaid Is Watching
author: Freida McFadden
summary: The third Housemaid book. Millie tries for a quieter life in a new neighbourhood, but her instincts pick up that something about the people nearby is not right.
readIf: you want another compulsive installment with short chapters and sharp reveals.
skipIf: you have not read the earlier books and want to avoid spoilers for them.

pairings.reason: Another thriller about a woman whose watching of other people draws her into danger, with a reliable twist.
Shares the premise of an observer who may be the only one who sees what is going on next door.
A darker, more literary domestic thriller with a more devastating mind behind the twists.
